notifications.title: Achievement: Dawn over Prav
notifications.body: Hold the Holy City through Ritual Night.

notifications.title: The Kalinov Bridge holds
notifications.body: The last horde broke against the walls and the rite was finished. The Kalinov Bridge runs from Nav through Yav to Prav, the gods' light holds it end to end, the road from Nav is shut, and the bells of the Holy City ring for the first time in a generation. The old faith lives on, because you held.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 2 rounds.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (2, -1)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 2100 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: The captives at (2, 0) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Dobrynya reached level 2
notifications.body: A new skill point to spend.

notifications.title: Vruchiy held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten after 3 rounds.

notifications.title: Achievement: Shield of the Village
notifications.body: Beat a horde at one of your villages.

notifications.title: Achievement: Many Banners
notifications.body: Stand against two hordes in one battle.

notifications.title: Another horde joins the battle at (-2, 2)
notifications.body: 27 more from the south fight alongside the horde already there.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 22 of them against its guard of 33.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 2 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Vruchiy
notifications.body: The moderate south horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Ritual Night
notifications.body: With the arch raised, the volkhvs begin the rite that will join the bridge to Prav. Every horde in Nav feels it. Tonight they all come at once, from every front, to break the city before the last words are spoken.

notifications.title: Achievement: Stone upon Stone
notifications.body: Raise a stage of the Kalinov Bridge.

notifications.title: The Ritual Arch stands
notifications.body: The Kalinov Bridge is whole. Ritual Night is coming.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-6, 4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: Vruchiy is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 15 is fighting your garrison of 4.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 15 of them against its guard of 32.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Vruchiy
notifications.body: The moderate north horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Raising The Ritual Arch
notifications.body: Everything it needs is in place; the builders are at work.

notifications.title: Nav strikes at the builders
notifications.body: While The Ritual Arch is raised, every front sends a band at a different target.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, 0)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: Barracks level 1 in Vruchiy
notifications.body: Finished.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (0, -5).
